pruning: Nothing of libpng is vendored: the library is compat.libpng 1.6.43 (over compat.zlib 1.3.2), built from the same tarball with upstream's scripts/pnglibconf.h.prebuilt as its pnglibconf.h. Its README and license are retained here. The conformance test (examples/pngtest) is a C++ port of the release's pngtest.c and runs on the release's own test images, downloaded at test time.
